subject: Fast-track supplier registration: W-9, EIN OTP, and document audit trail
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@sprint-holdings.com>
To: david.kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@sprint-holdings.com
Date: 2026-04-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplier registration: Redwood Inference — W-9 and EIN verification

Hi David,

We're moving Redwood through Sprint Holdings' supplier registration this week. Procurement needs a completed W-9 and a quick confirmation that your EIN checks via our verification flow (we do an OTP to the tax contact). Target for PO issuance is EOD Friday (10th) if we have the documents validated.

Quick asks:
- Please return a signed W-9 (PDF) with Redwood's legal name exactly as it appears on filings.
- Can your team confirm the EIN OTP flow? We will trigger an OTP to the tax contact and need the verification log back for audit.
- If available, a bank letter (on bank letterhead, scanned) helps speed ACH setup.

If there's anything preventing a simple e-signature, flag it and we'll accept a notarized scan, but the fast-track needs e-signed W-9 + OTP log.

Thanks — we have a procurement window next week so timely response appreciated.

Alex Torres
Sr. Procurement Manager
Sprint Holdings
[attachment: supplier_registration_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <alex.torres@sprint-holdings.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-07T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier registration: Redwood Inference — W-9 and EIN verification

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear checklist. We're set up to fast-track this. Action plan below: 

1) W-9: Attached is our standard fillable W-9. I'll sign and DocuSign it tonight and share the signed PDF first thing tomorrow morning. If you prefer a specific signatory name on page 1, let me know; otherwise I'll include the company officer details on file.

2) EIN OTP: We use the IRS EIN verification partner (finance runs the OTP). Ben in finance will trigger and capture the OTP verification record; we'll provide a time-stamped log (screenshot + text file) that shows the OTP was delivered and accepted. If you require the raw request/response from the verification API, we can provide an anonymized extract for audit.

3) Bank letter: We'll request a bank-issued ACH confirmation. If turnaround is slow, we can provide a cancelled check plus the bank's contact as an interim artifact — will flag in the email.

Internal note: Monica, Ben — please prioritize the OTP run and attach the verification log here when done. If OTP succeeds within 24 hours, procurement can proceed to PO creation under expedited terms.

Alex — attaching our blank W-9 for signature: [attachment: Redwood_W9_fillable.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB)].

Regards,
David Kim
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
[internal: please route any red flags through procurement-review@redwood.ai]
